description_en: Queries a list of snapshot jobs
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-snapshot-jobs --start-of-create-time 2022-07-12T00:00:00Z --end-of-create-time 2022-07-14T00:00:00Z --status Success --order-by CreateTimeDesc --job-id 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --page-size 20 --next-page-token 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSnapshotJobs

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间
parameters.name: start_of_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间
parameters.name: end_of_create_time

parameters.help_en:
The state of the job.

Valid values:

Init: The job is submitted.

Success: The job is successful.

Fail: The job failed
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The order that you use to sort the query results.

CreateTimeDesc

CreateTimeAsc

Valid values:

CreateTimeDesc: sorts the jobs by creation time in descending order

CreateTimeAsc: sorts the jobs by creation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值：
CreateTimeAsc
CreateTimeDesc
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为20，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记
parameters.name: next_page_token

items.description_en: The information about the snapshot job

Async.description_en: Indicates whether the snapshots were captured in asynchronous mode

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was complete

Media.description_en: The input file. If Type is set to OSS, the URL of an OSS object is returned. If Type is set to Media, the ID of a media asset is returned. The URL of an OSS object can be in one of the following formats: 1. OSS://bucket/object 2. http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object In the URL, bucket specifies an OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the job, and object specifies the object URL in OSS
Media.description_zh:
输入媒体。当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址，Type为Media时填入媒资ID。
OSS地址规则为：

OSS://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

OSS: an Object Storage Service (OSS) object.

Media: a media asset
Type.description_zh:
输入类型，取值：
OSS：oss文件地址
Media：媒资ID

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the job was last modified

Media.description_en:
The output file. If Type is set to OSS, the URL of an OSS object is returned. If Type is set to Media, the ID of a media asset is returned. The URL of an OSS object can be in one of the following formats:

OSS://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In the URL, bucket specifies an OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the job, and object specifies the object URL in OSS. If multiple static snapshots were captured, the object must contain the "{Count}" placeholder. In the case of a sprite, the object must contain the "{TileCount}" placeholder. The suffix of the WebVTT snapshot objects must be ".vtt"
Media.description_zh:
输出媒体。当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址，Type为Media时填入媒资ID。
OSS地址规则为：

OSS://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径。

截取多张静态截图时，object必须要带有”{Count}“占位符。

截取雪碧图时，object必须要带有“{TileCount}”占位符。

WebVTT截图object的后缀必须是“.vtt”

Type.description_en:
The type of the output file. Valid values:

Media: a media asset
Type.description_zh:

Media：媒资ID
